title: Projects & Case Studies
text:
This section highlights selected academic and professional projects that reflect my skills in business strategy, customer engagement, and retail operations.



Role: Sales Associate | Location: McArthurGlen, Vancouver
- Applied the GUEST model to enhance customer satisfaction and drive sales.
- Developed strong product knowledge to offer tailored watch and accessory recommendations.
- Contributed to loss prevention and inventory management initiatives.
- Maintained visual merchandising standards in alignment with brand guidelines.




Role: Cashier | Location: Hyderabad, India
- Managed high-volume transactions while maintaining cash accuracy.
- Streamlined customer flow during peak hours by guiding them to open counters.
- Supported promotional activities for loyalty programs and store services.
- Helped improve team coordination and queue efficiency at the front end.




Role: Sales Associate | Location: Nizamabad, India
- Conducted informal needs assessments to recommend the best-fit products.
- Improved customer engagement through proactive communication and personalized support.
- Participated in team briefings to stay aligned on promotions and safety updates.
- Followed store opening and closing procedures for operational readiness.




Institution: Telangana University | Title: Retail Strategy & Consumer Behavior
- Investigated consumer behavior in tier-2 cities with a focus on pricing, display, and service quality.
- Designed and distributed surveys to collect primary data.
- Analyzed results in Excel and presented actionable insights to faculty and peers.

These projects demonstrate my hands-on understanding of business operations, sales effectiveness, and customer-centered retail practices.
